user.title: Connect a Pill Pal
user.description: Set the lamp up in the Bindicator app first. Then enter its address, which the app shows under the lamp's settings.

discovery_confirm.description: Connect Pill Pal {name} to Home Assistant? You approve the connection in the Bindicator app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Pill Pal {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The lamp no longer accepts Home Assistant. It was removed in the app, or the lamp was reset. Continue to ask again, then approve it in the Bindicator app.

progress.wait_for_approval: Open the Bindicator app on a phone that controls this lamp and approve "{name}". Check the app shows this code: **{code}**. If the codes differ, decline.

abort.declined: The connection was declined in the app.
abort.expired: Nobody approved the connection within 10 minutes. Start again when you have the app open.
abort.not_pill_pal: That device is not a Pill Pal.
abort.unsupported_api: This lamp needs a newer version of this integration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Pill Pal at that address.

unknown_device.message: That device is not a connected Pill Pal.

not_authorised.message: The lamp no longer accepts Home Assistant. Reconnect it from the integration page.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Play a short pattern, then go back to what the lamp was showing. A touch stops it early.

set_status.name: Set status
set_status.description: Show a status until it is cleared. Setting the same ID again updates it. A tap on the lamp dims it.

status_id.name: Status ID
status_id.description: Your name for it: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore, up to 23 characters.

label.name: Label
label.description: Shown in the app, not on the lamp.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Higher statuses are shown first when there is not room for all of them.

clears_at.name: Clear at
clears_at.description: Optional. The lamp clears it at this time.

clear_status.name: Clear status
clear_status.description: Remove a status this integration set.

status_id.name: Status ID
status_id.description: The ID it was set with.

set_gauge.name: Set gauge
set_gauge.description: Fill the lamp to a level from 0 to 1. It shows as stale if no new value arrives in time.

color.name: Colour
color.description: The colour at the full end, or the only colour.

color_end.name: Empty-end colour
color_end.description: Optional. With it, the fill is a gradient.

stale_after.name: Stale after
stale_after.description: Seconds without a new value before the lamp shows the gauge as stale.

clear_gauge.name: Clear gauge
clear_gauge.description: Remove the gauge. The lamp goes back to its ambient scene.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge reminder
acknowledge.description: Acknowledge one reminder by its occurrence ID. Future reminders are not affected.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: From the lamp's state or a touch event.

snooze.name: Snooze reminder
snooze.description: Snooze one reminder by its occurrence ID for 10 minutes.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: From the lamp's state or a touch event.
